request.briefing_text:
# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000-$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (GTM) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s commercial challenge extends beyond demonstrating that Claude is useful. The larger task is making enterprise adoption consistent through external delivery channels while protecting the company’s standards for safety,
reliability,
and product quality.

This position operates between a frontier-model company’s platform expectations and an ecosystem in which cloud providers, technology firms, and consultancies influence solution design, implementation quality, and customer outcomes.

The central operating tension is clear: expand partner-delivered adoption without allowing inconsistent practices to weaken technical rigor, security expectations, or responsible-use principles.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation founded in 2021. It presents itself as an AI safety and research company focused on reliable, interpretable, and steerable systems.

Its operating model combines frontier-model research with enterprise software delivery. Claude is the main product surface for business users, developers, and organizations deploying AI at scale. The company’s differentiation relies on
making safety-oriented model development meaningful in real customer environments.

Anthropic is not primarily a professional-services business. Partners therefore serve as important multipliers of implementation capacity, vertical expertise, procurement access, and organizational change support.

For a technical ecosystem leader, the practical mandate is to turn a fast-moving AI platform into reusable solution patterns, enablement materials, deployment guidance, and operating practices that partners can apply repeatedly.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic must translate broad enterprise interest in generative AI into sustained use across knowledge work, software development, data-intensive processes, and customer-specific applications.

Its enterprise proposition includes security, compliance, administrative controls, and support for organizational rollout. Enterprise value therefore depends on more than access to a model: customers need governance, technical readiness,
adoption planning, and durable operating ownership.

A likely pressure point is the boundary between centrally managed product and safety standards and decentralized learning from field implementations. Partners can surface recurring needs, but Product and Engineering must determine which
needs become supported capabilities, documented patterns, or partner-managed services.

The strongest ecosystem model will distinguish between repeatable needs that should be standardized and specialized work that remains account-specific. That discipline can protect quality while keeping field learning close to product
decisions.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
The internal stakeholder environment spans Partnerships, enterprise commercial teams, Product, Engineering, security and trust functions, developer-facing organizations, and customer adoption groups.

External stakeholders include cloud-platform technical teams, systems-integrator practice leaders, alliance organizations, architects, delivery managers, and enterprise technology executives. Their incentives differ materially:
cloud providers seek infrastructure usage, service firms seek scalable offerings, and buyers seek measurable value with controlled risk.

An effective operating model needs explicit ownership for partner selection, technical validation, reusable assets, field readiness, escalation, deployment feedback, and cross-functional prioritization.

The key leadership signal is the ability to align groups with different incentives around deployment quality and customer outcomes, rather than treating each alliance as a collection of isolated activities.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Claude supports problem solving across analysis, writing, coding, and enterprise workflows. This creates architectural relevance across employee productivity, embedded applications, developer tooling, and governed business processes.

Anthropic’s enterprise materials describe implementation as a staged journey that includes technical preparation, organizational launch, adoption, and continuing operations. This signals that successful deployment is viewed as both a
technical and organizational challenge.

Security, compliance, and administrative controls are central to the enterprise posture. Partner-delivered solutions must therefore address identity, permissions, governance, adoption, support boundaries, and operational accountability,
not only prompts or integrations.

Anthropic’s emphasis on safety and reliability increases the importance of practical guardrails. Reference designs need to remain useful for customers while reflecting supported product behavior, secure implementation choices, and
responsible-use expectations.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic presents a network spanning cloud, technology, and services organizations. This suggests that alliances are a meaningful route to enterprise adoption rather than a secondary resale mechanism.

The ecosystem can support several connected motions:
- Technology companies can integrate Claude into established software ecosystems and customer operating environments.

Anthropic and Accenture publicly describe an enterprise AI deployment relationship. That signal supports the view that consultative implementation capacity and repeatable organizational adoption matter alongside developer access.

The ecosystem opportunity is to move beyond isolated demonstrations toward partner practices that can identify use cases, shape technical approaches, guide implementation, support customer uptake, and return structured lessons to
Anthropic.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s public enterprise guidance and adoption learning materials indicate an increasing focus on operational rollout, administrator readiness, and organizational change in addition to model capability.

Its partner presence and enterprise resources point to a need for scale beyond direct company involvement. As buyers move from experimentation to governed production use, the consistency of partner delivery becomes a product,
reputation, and competitive concern.

The urgency is heightened by a market in which cloud platforms, model providers, software vendors, and consulting firms all seek influence over enterprise AI architecture and transformation decisions.

A partner technical organization can create leverage only if it establishes common standards early enough to prevent fragmented solution designs, uneven readiness, and customer experiences that vary widely by delivery firm.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Scaling partner technical programs while avoiding an operating model dependent on bespoke consulting.
- Equipping cloud and consulting technical communities with practical architecture guidance and field education.
- Pairing commercial momentum with clear security, governance, and responsible-use expectations.
- Shaping joint offerings around measurable workflow adoption rather than generalized AI exploration.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s partner ecosystem makes implementation quality an extension of the Claude customer experience.
- Safety and reliability positioning makes partner readiness a governance issue as well as a commercial lever.
- A mature feedback loop can help distinguish product gaps from delivery-method gaps and enablement gaps.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims, accomplishments, leadership scope, technical depth, and partnership outcomes must come from the governed resume/proof graph.

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD
